title: fix(console): the ungrouped field-group bucket renders under its own "Other" heading
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XG6f9pSpWtMtrSxqCdsvY2T)_

Fixes #33229

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对象声明了字段分组时,没有归入任何分组的字段现在在所有分组之后单独成段,带自己的标题「其他 / Other」(按语言翻译);记录详情页、记录抽屉、以及新建/编辑表单(普通、弹窗、抽屉三种)都一样。没有声明任何分组的对象保持原样,不加标题。
- 为什么改:卡 #33229:这些字段原来没有标题,紧跟在最后一个分组下面;最后一个分组折叠时,它们看起来像是那个分组里被折叠的内容,用户会误以为是系统字段或找不到。
- 风险与回滚:纯界面默认值,不改 spec、不新增可编写的元数据键、不改存储;新增一个语言包键 `common.ungroupedSection`(11 种语言)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.ts(详情页给未分组段加标题与卡片边框)、ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts 的 `deriveFieldGroupSections` 第三参数、ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ungroupedFieldSection-11777.test.tsx(原 objectui#11777 断言改为读「字段上方的标题」)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm dev 后打开一个声明了 fieldGroups 且有未分组字段的对象记录页,把最后一个分组设为折叠:未分组字段出现在单独的「Other / 其他」标题下,而不是折叠分组的下面;编辑表单同样。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`deriveFieldGroupLayout` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, ADR-0085 §5) ends a grouped layout with a keyless bucket of every visible field no declared group claims. It returns `null` when no declared group applies, so the bucket only ever follows at least one declared group. The spec keeps it keyless; the Console now owns a presentation default for it.

- **Record page and record drawer** (`RecordDetailView`, which the drawer and the split pane embed): `deriveRecordDetailSections` heads the bucket's primary section with the new `labels.ungrouped` (the view passes `t('common.ungroupedSection', 'Other')`) and gives it the card chrome the declared groups have. Long-form ungrouped fields still go to "More details" after it. No `name` is set, so `record:details` shows the translated label as written and no per-object `_sections` key is invented.
- **Forms** (`ObjectForm`, `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`, each on its no-sections field-group fallback): `deriveFieldGroupSections(fields, fieldGroups, ungroupedLabel?)` labels the trailing bucket, including the case where it is only the re-appended rendered system fields. Each arm passes its translated `common.ungroupedSection`, so the one row rule draws a divider row for it and the bucket is a titled section like the groups. It has no collapse control.
- **Language packs**, all eleven: `common.ungroupedSection` added ("Other", 「其他」, 「其他」 zh-Hant via `gen:zh-hant`, "Sonstiges", "Otros", "Autres", "その他", "기타", "Outros", "Прочее", "أخرى"). Nothing reworded or removed. Measured before adding: no existing key says exactly this. The "Other" keys in the tree are each scoped to another surface (`capability.group.other`, `console.reportIndex.otherSection`, a marketplace category, an artifact kind).
- **Studio callers** of the same derivation (`anchors.ts` page-create seed, `PagePreview.tsx`) pass the new label too (`UNGROUPED_SECTION_DEFAULT_LABEL` / the translated key). They only reach `deriveRecordDetailSections` when no field groups apply, so what they write and draw is unchanged.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/field-grouping-and-order.mdx` say the bucket is drawn under its own "Other" heading. Comments that called the derived bucket "untitled, no row" (`fieldGroups.ts`, `ObjectForm.tsx`, `@object-ui/components` `splitAtUntitledRuns`) now describe the authored untitled section that path still serves.
- Changeset `.changeset/33229-ungrouped-section-heading.md` (`@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`: patch). `@object-ui/app-shell` is private; the `@object-ui/components` edit is comment-only.

## Tests

- `RecordDetailView.sectionHeadingsRenderPath-6190.test.tsx`, new top-level describe on the existing mounted-`RecordDetailView` harness (no assigned page, the synthesized page): with the last declared group `collapse: 'collapsed'`, "Other" is on screen, the collapsed member is folded away, the ungrouped field is on screen, and the smallest block holding "Other" and the ungrouped field does not hold the collapsed group's heading; reading order is groups, "Other", its field, then "More details". zh-CN under a real `I18nProvider` reads 「其他」 and no "Other". CONTROL: an object with no field groups renders no "Other".
- `ungroupedFieldSection-11777.test.tsx`, new top-level describe run on all three arms (`ObjectForm`, `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`): under a collapsed group the bucket's fields sit under their own "Other" row, which follows the group's row and carries no disclosure control; zh-CN reads 「其他」; CONTROL: no declared group applies, no heading; CONTROL: an authored untitled section stays headerless.
- Ablations (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored blob equal to HEAD each time; `@object-ui/*` resolves to `src` through the vitest aliases, so no rebuild):
  - record page label dropped (`{ ...primary, label: labels.ungrouped, showBorder: true }` → no label): 2 failed / 5 passed (the collapsed-group and zh-CN rows; the CONTROL stays green).
  - form bucket label dropped in `deriveFieldGroupSections`: 12 failed / 18 passed (the two rewritten objectui#11777 rows and the two new heading rows, on each of the three arms; the controls stay green).

## Acceptance notes

- **The objectui#11777 rows were rewritten, not only extended.** They read "the bucket is a separate grid block" (the `splitAtUntitledRuns` split of an untitled run). The bucket is now a titled section, and the form renderer draws titled sections in one grid separated by their divider rows, as it draws any two groups. So those rows now read "the heading above each ungrouped field is Other, not the group's". The untitled split itself stays pinned by the file's authored-untitled-section row, which is unchanged and green. `PagePreview.test.tsx` and `PagePreview.authoredDetailsValues-27177.test.tsx` changed only their label argument, and `check:test-source-alias` then asked each for the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint';` its siblings carry. Two older heading-list pins whose fixtures leave a field ungrouped now expect the bucket's row after the group's on the derived arms: `sectionDividerProjection-9849.test.tsx` (blocks 1, 2 and 4, via a `trailing` entry on the three DERIVED arms) and `drawerFormSectionDescription-9834.test.tsx` row 3.
- **Surfaces checked and left as they are.** Studio's page-create seed and its slotted preview, for an object whose field groups apply, write the synthesizer's own `{ group }` references plus an enumerated untitled bucket (`fieldGroupSectionReferences` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, left so by the earlier page-seed cards). That is an authored page once saved, and its author owns the section's label. Labelling the persisted seed would change what Studio writes, which is outside this card's renderer-only route. The Studio object form designer and canvas keep their own authoring label "Ungrouped". `RecordDetailDrawer` (inline-edit drawer in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`) does not read `fieldGroups`. A `record:details` node an author writes with an untitled section keeps it untitled.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, measured on the diff: one added catalogue key in the published `@object-ui/i18n`. `deriveFieldGroupSections` is not exported from the `@object-ui/plugin-form` entry, so its new optional parameter widens no public surface; that package changes only what its arms draw. Nothing removed or renamed. No `packages/spec` edit and no new authorable key, per the order's route.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates, suites and type-checks (head bfbc379f)</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` on this diff derives 70 families. All 70 ran on f52c0a1d and exited 0, except `check:test-source-alias` (exit 1: the two PagePreview tests above). The fix landed as bfbc379f; on that head `check:test-source-alias` and the other test-reading families (`cross-package-test-inputs`, `query-options-erasure`, `undeclared-dep-imports`, `nul-bytes`, `where-matcher`, `engine-double-contract`, `driver-memory-census`, `refd-timer-probe`, `registry-log-declared`, `rest-log-spy-declared`, `watch-hint-literal`, `type-check-coverage`) exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check:skill-examples` exited 3 on the first round (stale `@objectstack/client-react` dist, nothing measured); after building that package it exits 0.
- Type-check (`type-check` = `tsc --noEmit` + `tsconfig.test.json`): `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components` exit 0 (plugin-form re-run on f52c0a1d).
- Suites, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run`: `packages/plugin-form/` 231 files, 2555 passed, 1 skipped (f52c0a1d); `packages/i18n/` 102 files, 1894 passed, 13 skipped; app-shell narrowed to the record view and the Studio callers (`views/RecordDetailView*`, `views/recordDetailSections*`, `metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview*`, `metadata-admin/anchors*`) 106 files, 764 passed. The rest of app-shell is CI's sharded Test UI. The two PagePreview files re-run on bfbc379f: 10 passed.
- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` rewrote nothing.
- eslint on the touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors.

</details>
